observed_problem: The Quality Review Bundle stored research_profile/publication_profile labels but was not bound to the authoritative Production Profile. build_bundle inferred WEEKLY from a Weekly issue ID and otherwise defaulted to THEMATIC/LONGFORM_SPECIAL when callers omitted explicit profile arguments. A RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD issue could therefore silently receive the Thematic quality family, omitting Period-specific checks; callers could also explicitly supply a profile pair that did not match the edition Profile. Publication Candidate validation did not reject a quality bundle whose publication_profile differed from the candidate's publication_profile.
expected_behavior: Quality applicability must derive from and bind the exact Production Profile, never from issue-ID heuristics or caller-declared labels. The Quality Bundle must preserve the exact Profile authority and its research/publication identities. Publication Candidate validation must require the coupled Quality Bundle to match the Candidate/edition publication profile.
actual_behavior: Quality bundle construction now requires production_profile_path, validates and hashes that exact Production Profile, derives research_profile/publication_profile and applicable quality checks only from it, and revalidates Profile bytes/identity whenever the bundle is consumed. The issue-ID fallback was removed. Retrospective Period regressions prove Period-specific checks are selected from the bound Profile. Publication Candidate build/validation now rejects any publication_profile that differs from the coupled Quality bundle's bound Production Profile.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Bound Quality Review Bundles to the exact Production Profile, removed unsafe issue-ID inference, derived applicable checks only from that Profile, and enforced Publication Candidate/Profile consistency.
